Vendored front-end libraries (pinned, served locally so the CSP can be
strict and the app needs no third-party origin at runtime).

marked=18.1.3   (https://github.com/markedjs/marked, MIT)
  source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@18.1.3/lib/marked.umd.js
dompurify=3.4.17 (https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify, Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0)
  source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.4.17/dist/purify.min.js

To upgrade: fetch the new build, then re-run the sanitizer check in the README
and the test suite.
